depends_on.name: software_id
depends_on.documentation: The reader program itself, as a `software` entity -- the R1 replacement for an NDI class-handle string. Same edge, same meaning and same optionality as on `acquisition_metadata_reader`.

fields.name: reader_string
fields.documentation: Reader/file-type string (e.g. 'intan', 'SpikeGadgets') -- the de-encoded did_v1 `daqreader_ndr.ndr_reader_string`. Optional: the concrete reader is discriminated by its `software` entity, and only some readers take a format selector.
